character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist throughout every scene: long dusty-lilac hair in a loose side braid, soft violet eyes, with a distinctive stable face and consistent adult proportions. They are a lavender farmer and beekeeper tending the hillside fields. Their fixed signature outfit is a cream blouse, muted purple apron dress, straw hat, and leather garden boots. Their defining personal object is a tiny honey jar tied with a lavender ribbon. Preserve this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, clothing silhouette, and personal object across the full music video.
consistency_rules: Maintain this exact protagonist as the sole lead throughout the theme.
Keep face, hair shape and color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions stable in every scene.
Preserve the signature costume design and its identifying accessory or personal object.
Do not change the lead's identity or introduce a second protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in rolling lavender fields, stone farmhouse among rows, dusty country road; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with lavender purple, sage green, honey gold, stone cream; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide aerial shot of curving purple rows, low tracking along a flowering furrow, close-up of bees on blossoms; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
